103: And according to Rabbi Yoḥanan, who says - in Chapter "The Gold" (Bava Matzia 46b:6).
By Torah law money effects acquisition - as we find regarding sanctified property: He will give the money and it will be assured to him (see Leviticus 27:19).

He could answer - don't raise an objection to me from the mishna, because the tanna of the mishna is referring to an ordinance of the Rabbis. The Rabbis abrogated acquisition through money, and said that acquisition takes place only through pulling. This is decreed lest [the seller] tell [the buyer] "your wheat was burned in a loft" (Kiddushin 28b:5).
